title: Paul et al. 2015 mouse myeloid progenitor expression matrix distributed by Scanpy
study_ids: Paul2015; source paper identifier and DOI not resolved from inspected files

provenance.status: observed study data, adapted as an AnnData tutorial fixture
provenance.description: Scanpy documents non-logarithmized raw data sent by email from the Amit Lab. Loader reads debatched expression, cell/gene names and cluster IDs, constructs annotations, removes duplicate gene aliases and restricts to informative genes; sets root iroot=840 based on Haghverdi et al. 2016.
provenance.adaptations: Loader coerces matrix to float32, transposes rows to observations, annotates cell types and filters informative genes. Tutorial resets to float64 for precision before downstream analysis.

biological_context.assay: Single-cell expression; precise assay and experimental design not described by inspected loader.
biological_context.design: Mouse myeloid progenitor differentiation; returned matrix has 3451 genes and cluster annotation paul15_clusters.
biological_context.metadata: Cell-type-like cluster categories include Ery, MEP, Mk, GMP, DC, Baso, Mo, Neu, Eos and Lymph; source paper context describes myeloid progenitors.

assets.processing_stage: Debatched expression with cluster, cell/gene name and informative-gene arrays, adapted by loader into AnnData
assets.relationship: Primary Scanpy-hosted asset; registry fallback is https://falexwolf.de/data/paul15.h5.

access_and_terms.access: Scanpy fetches from exampledata.scverse.org; fallback URL recorded in registry.
sources: src/scanpy/datasets/_datasets.py, function paul15 at pinned revision

inspection.checked: Loader docstring and data transformation code plus registry URL/hash; dataset bytes not downloaded or executed.
unverified: Original accession, assay metadata, study design, license/redistribution terms and asset byte size.

limitations: Loader docstring says its final restriction is to 3461 informative genes, while its example return shape and inspected installed source imply 3451; this inconsistency remains unresolved.
A root cell is supplied by loader, but its independent biological validity was not assessed.
